evidence.heading: Price and value
evidence.excerpt: You do not need the most expensive shoe to run well. Good daily trainers cost from 100 and 160 dollars, and last year's models are often discounted by thirty percent. Carbon plated racing shoes cost more and wear out faster, so save them for race day rather than daily mileage.
